def declarer(user):
    app = user.add_appliance(name="grain_milling", number=1, power=7500,
        num_windows=1, func_time=641, func_cycle=15,

        occasional_use=1.000, flat="no", thermal_p_var=0,
        time_fraction_random_variability=0, pref_index=0, wd_we_type=2)
    app.windows(random_var_w=0.0, window_1=[405, 1260])

    app.specific_cycle(2, p_21=7500, t_21=9, p_22=6.0, t_22=54, r_c2=0, cw21=[855, 1020], cw22=[1215, 1260])
    app.specific_cycle(3, p_31=7500, t_31=11, p_32=6.0, t_32=32, r_c3=0, cw31=[420, 780], cw32=[1020, 1215])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    # profil moyen de 480 jours simules ; moteur RAMP du depot DBSCAN-RAMP-PUE-V4
    import sys, pathlib
    sys.path.insert(0, str(pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[5] / "DBSCAN-RAMP-PUE-V4"))
    from ramp import User, UseCase
    uc = UseCase(name="pue", date_start="2024-01-01", date_end="2025-04-25")
    user = User(user_name="client", num_users=1)
    uc.add_user(user)
    declarer(user)
    profil = uc.generate_daily_load_profiles(flat=False, continuous=True)
